title: Sketchup to Unreal Engine
description: In this course from the Epic Online Learning team, you’ll learn how to convert your SketchUp projects to Unreal Engine 5 with ease. We look at how to organize your SketchUp scenes and UV map your objects with the SketchUV plug-in in preparation for export. Import your SketchUp scene using Datasmith for a one-way conversion, or use the Direct Link to update your SketchUp and Unreal Engine scenes at the same time. Explore some built-in lighting options using HDRI backdrops to give your scene realistic lighting. And finally, take a high-resolution image of your scene or create an interactive walkthrough.
